definition: KLHL20 refers to the gene encoding Kelch-like protein 20, a substrate receptor for cullin–RING E3 ubiquitin ligases whose pathogenic missense variants are implicated in an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by early-onset seizures, facial dysmorphism, and behavioral abnormalities (OMIM #621390).
